source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: With **ADEPTA SORORITAS** as your [Army Faction](vsdata:core-rule/select-army-faction), each of your units that has **Acts of Faith** may use it once per phase. Gain one **Miracle die** at every turn’s start and one whenever you lose an **ADEPTA SORORITAS** unit. Roll a D6 per die gained. Keep the resulting **Miracle dice** in your pool. Its value stays fixed unless a rule permits a change or re-roll. Before the unit or one of its models rolls, decide whether to substitute one saved die. The permitted rolls are [Advance](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move), [Battle-shock](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock), [Charge](vsdata:core-rule/charge-phase), Damage, Hit, saving throw and [Wound](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls). Even on a multiple-die roll, use only one **Miracle die**. Roll the other dice normally. The substituted value counts as unmodified. Remove the die from the pool when spent. For example, spending a stored 4 changes a 2D6 [Battle-shock](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock) test to D6+4.
